s.default: even output in the last dimension
s.description: Signal size in the transformed dimensions. If given, each dimension ``dim[i]`` will either be zero-padded or trimmed to the length ``s[i]`` before computing the Hermitian FFT. If a length ``-1`` is specified, no padding is done in that dimension. Defaults to even output in the last dimension: ``s[-1] = 2*(input.size(dim[-1]) - 1)``.
constraints: s must be one of -1, FFT

dim.description: Dimensions to be transformed. The last dimension must be the half-Hermitian compressed dimension. Default: last two dimensions.
